subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to complete the given sentence.**

They were not able to get the item from the store because it was __ __ .
solution:
The correct answer is** 'out of stock'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option for the given blank is** 'out of stock'.**
 
• The correct answer is **"out of stock"**.** "Out of stock"** means that the store has run out of the item and does not have it available for sale at the moment.
 
• Let's see why other options can't be the answer:
 
 
• Option 1 **"in fashion" **means that the item is currently trendy or popular.
 
• Option 2 **"in vain"** means that their attempt to get the item was unsuccessful.
 
• Option 4 **"on leave"** means that the store is closed temporarily, usually because the staff is taking time off.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate option to complete the sentence is **"out of stock".**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *They were not able to get the item from the store because it was **out of stock.***** **
